{{Quote|Protas met Melkorr upon the ridge of Thalina, and there they fought|Ryan Kaufman, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
'''Thalina''' was an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] ridge on the<ref name="tale" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kamino">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], according to the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] legend "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]." In the tale, Thalina was the location where the [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]] and the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] titan [[Melkorr]] [[Battle of Thalina|battled]]. Melkorr had challenged Protas for rule of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of Kamino and, after the challenge was accepted, they fought. Protas used his agility to tire his opponent, and for six [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and six nights the two battled, before Protas [[Death/Legends|killed]] the challenger.<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thalina appeared in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[List of short stories|short story]] "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)|The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]," which was written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="tale" />
